met_analysis:
The Low-Pressure Area over Jharkhand & neighbourhood persisted over the same region at 1430 Hrs IST of today, the 25th August 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 5.8 km above mean sea level tilting southwards with height. The system is likely to move nearly west-northwestwards during the next 24 hours.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Jammu, Dehradun, Shahjahanpur, Prayagraj, centre of Low Pressure Area over Jharkhand & neighbourhood and Digha & thence southeastwards to Northwest Bay of Bengal and extends upto 4.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Assam & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 7.6 km above mean sea level now runs roughly along Long. 72°E to the north of Lat. 28°N.
